notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write these notes. None of my research tools worked, so I didn't read a single page from the approved sites.

My first attempt to open the commentary pages directly (enduringword.com, biblehub.com for Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit and Matthew Henry, and preceptaustin.org) was blocked. The tool will only open a page after a search has turned it up. When I then tried to run my searches, I hit the tool's usage limit before any results came back. The tool then refused any more calls for this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point, and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Without any pages, anything I wrote would come from memory with no URLs behind it, so I've left the notes out entirely.

**How we can continue:** if you ask again in a new message, I'll work in smaller steps, starting with a few searches so the pages can be opened:
1. **Verse-by-verse sources:** Enduring Word, Biblehub (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit), Precept Austin and NET Bible notes on Matthew 28.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** mainly v. 19, on infant versus believer's baptism (Lutheran, Reformed and Methodist versus Baptist teachers) and the Trinitarian wording versus "in Jesus' name" (Oneness Pentecostal) baptism. Also v. 17, "some doubted."
3. **Other views:** Bible Odyssey on the stolen-body story in vv. 11–15, and Catholic and Orthodox sources on vv. 19–20.

You could also send the commentary links or paste the text, and I'll build the notes only from what you give me.
